Shape the world.

We're accelerating the world's transition towards smart, responsible, and profitable supply chains. Join a team where you can shape the future.
See current openings

At Chainlane, we believe everyone has a seat at the table, and when you're with us, you'll always be heard. Here, everyone has the chance to effect real change, drive impact, and shape the future of supply chain transparency.

As a scale-up, we're growing fast. Be part of our growth story and you'll have the opportunity to influence, design, and create for leading global brands and partners, working alongside some of the best talent in the business as your co-workers.

Democratising the world of supply chain transparency and inventory management takes the right sort of people. Which is why we're committed to your well-being and care, ensuring our culture is positive and fun, with a good work-life balance and plenty of opportunities along the way.
